versions.changelog:
Initial release of multi-role-tts-skill.

- Generate multi-character dialogue audio using Edge TTS and FFmpeg
- Supports script parsing, automatic voice assignment, and spatial audio positioning
- Provides easy configuration of voices, speed, volume, and spatial layout via JSON
- Includes detailed documentation, usage guides, best practices, and troubleshooting
- Offers example scripts and batch processing utilities for streamlined workflow
- Open source and ready for community contributions
